title: Heian period begins
summary: The court moves to Heian-kyō (Kyoto), opening a classical age of Japanese court culture.
body: The Tale of Genji and kana literature belong to this world. Political power later drifted to Fujiwara regents and then to warriors, but the cultural canon stayed. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Sansom, A History of Japan to 1334
